target:
def Target : Prop :=
  ∀ T : Set Form, Def14 T (ex 1 Def16) → Def14 T (ex 1 (and Def17 (neg (K Def17))))
a_raw: {"translation":"Let R(a,b) denote the atom with relation index 0 and variable arguments a and b. Target is the proposition that for every set T of formulas, if ‘∃x₁ ∀x₀ (K(¬R(x₀,x₀)) ↔ R(x₁,x₀))’ is derivable from T, then ‘∃x₁ (¬R(x₁,x₁) ∧ ¬K(¬R(x₁,x₁)))’ is derivable from the same T. In both cases, derivability means using Def13 axioms and members of T, with modus ponens as the only inference rule. No consistency or closure condition is imposed on T, and the premise formula need not itself belong to T. The existential quantifiers are part of the two separate object-language formulas; no witness is supplied or required to be shared between them."}
translation: Let R(a,b) denote the atom with relation index 0 and variable arguments a and b. Target is the proposition that for every set T of formulas, if ‘∃x₁ ∀x₀ (K(¬R(x₀,x₀)) ↔ R(x₁,x₀))’ is derivable from T, then ‘∃x₁ (¬R(x₁,x₁) ∧ ¬K(¬R(x₁,x₁)))’ is derivable from the same T. In both cases, derivability means using Def13 axioms and members of T, with modus ponens as the only inference rule. No consistency or closure condition is imposed on T, and the premise formula need not itself belong to T. The existential quantifiers are part of the two separate object-language formulas; no witness is supplied or required to be shared between them.

divergences.description: The target fixes U(e,x) to the atom with relation index 0. Reinhardt allows any formula with free variables e and x, including arithmetic formulas outside the declared fragment.

Relative to the schematic theorem, the target assumes derivability of a) only for p(x) = ¬U(x,x) and supplies q(e) = ¬U(e,e) explicitly rather than asserting that some q works. This is exactly the specialization justified by Reinhardt’s proof.

judgement.summary: Within the claimed scope, the implication is faithful: from T proving the diagonal instance of a), it concludes that the same T proves ∃e(q(e) ∧ ¬Kq(e)), with the existential inside the derivability judgment.
